basic_info.description: Charming 1 bedroom home with soaring ceilings on quiet block of San Jose Avenue.  Situated between Noe Valley and The Mission District, the homes at 350 San Jose are the perfect urban sanctuaries. Residence 2 is unique in its high ceilings, open floor plan and private, exclusive-use garden space.  Bedroom suite is fit for a resort with double vanities, luxurious walk-in shower and closet with built-ins. Underfloor heating, fully integrated kitchen appliances and designer-finishes throughout.
